_about: An agenda step (kind 'agenda'), worded by convex/lib/ruleSteps.ts (stepSentence); a Python wording of the same step (scripts/lib_newsworthy.py) can read the same cases. The event's detail is what scripts/ingest_rule_pipeline.py writes (agenda_detail): the edition and its next step as printed. The sentence never claims a date: the agenda 'lists' the agency's own timetable.
